thread:
anya: Heads-up — I'm planning a variant swap for catalog model `sable-lite-v2` to pin to `sable-lite-v2-quant8` (8-bit) in staging at 11:30 PT today, then prod at 12:00 PT if smoke passes. Need volunteers for: smoke + latency checks, rollback owner, canary monitor. Also will add a brief config change (model pin) to the registry.

chris: I can own smoke in staging (latency + sample prompts). Will start at 11:30. Can you paste the pin diff?

maria: I'll watch canary/metrics and alerts. Which sampling buckets are we using? Prod only after a 30m canary?

anya: Yes — staging 11:30, prod 12:00. Canary 25% traffic for 30m. Rollback criteria: p50 > 2x baseline OR token error rate > 0.5% OR classification/regression test failures on our prompt set. I'll post the registry diff in a sec.

sre-bot: Scheduled deploy window: staging 11:30 PT, prod 12:00 PT — reminder in 10m. Runbooks: /runbooks/model-pins.md :hourglass_flowing_sand:

ben: Quick config snippet — include fallback variant `sable-lite-v2-fp16` in routing policy to make rollback fast.

ben: ```yaml
model_pins:
  sable-lite-v2:
    pinned_version: sable-lite-v2-quant8
    fallback: sable-lite-v2-fp16
    canary:
      percent: 25
      duration: 30m
```

chris: Got it. I'll run these prompts for smoke: `summarize`, `qa-checklist`, `translate`. Will paste results here.

maria: Also — let's disable aggressive KV cache prefetch during the canary, and warm caches in staging first.

anya: Good call. I'll run the KV warmer and replay a small traffic sample to staging before the swap. Will ping when staging smoke starts.

chris: Staging smoke done: all green. p50 145ms, p95 210ms, sample outputs look consistent with baseline. No hallucination regressions on the regression prompt set. :rocket:

maria: Monitoring steady — no error spikes, no latency alerts. Keeping an eye for the next 30m. :eyes:

anya: Prod push happening now (12:00 PT). rollback owner: ben — are you standing by?

ben: Standing by. Rollback command is: `/deploy rollback --model sable-lite-v2 --to sable-lite-v2-fp16`. I have infra access and will run it if we hit rollback thresholds.

sre-bot: Prod deploy completed: version `sable-lite-v2-quant8` active on 10 hosts. Health checks passed.

chris: Quick sanity check after prod: p50 160ms, p95 240ms, error rate 0.04% — looks good to me.

maria: Monitoring stable, continuing 30m watch. Will escalate if anything trends. :eyes:

anya: Thanks all — I'll create a short release note, pin this thread, and add the pin entry to the catalog registry.

chris: Thanks — great coordination.
note: variant swap, smoke checks, canary and rollback readiness for model catalog pin
